title: Reliable demo startup
details: Evia now repairs a saved Demo course before the main evidence screen starts if the local demo pack is missing or stale
Fresh browsers with no course no longer fall through to the course-map error while the welcome and demo setup is loading
The startup recovery is loaded before the evidence engine and is included in the offline shell
A fresh v224 service-worker cache forces existing v222 browsers onto the repaired startup path
The walkthrough, learner evidence, targets, QR activation and existing course behaviour are otherwise unchanged
summary: Evia v224 fixes the startup path that could leave a fresh or Demo laptop on the 'could not load the course map' screen.
changes: Added startup recovery before course evidence loading
Automatically restores the current Demo pack when Demo state exists
Prevents the no-course evidence loader from replacing first-run setup
Created a fresh v224 offline cache
